echo Baseline first. One change. Measure again.

overview: JAH’s end-of-life method: when a PC cannot meet the baseline after SSD+RAM+fresh OS, retire it to a lighter role (media box, kid PC, server) instead of endless tuning. Signature Method — an original optimization method by Justin Addam Higgins.

demo.code:
@echo off
REM Signature Retirement Plan - Signature Method
REM 1) BASELINE: winsat formal, note boot time, note temps
REM 2) Apply this ONE method, nothing else
REM 3) RE-MEASURE with the same tools
REM 4) Keep only if numbers improved
echo Method: Signature Retirement Plan
echo Baseline first. One change. Measure again.
demo.how_to_run: Save as sigmethod.bat and run — it prints the Signature optimization discipline

steps: Record your baseline first (boot time, benchmark, temps) — no baseline, no optimization
Apply the method exactly as described, changing nothing else
Re-measure with the same tools and compare to baseline
Keep the change only if the numbers improved; revert otherwise
Log the result with date in your optimization notes

commands.baseline: winsat formal (elevated) + note boot time + HWiNFO64 temps
commands.log: Keep a dated log of every change and its measured effect

expected_gain: Varies by method — measured, never assumed
risk: Low — every Signature Method change is reversible and measured
